sources.aridity: NASA GPM IMERG V07 monthly precipitation, mean annual total (mm)
sources.barren: MODIS MOD13A2 NDVI, yearly maximum averaged
sources.thermal_range: MODIS MOD11A2 LST day minus night, mean (K)
sources.dust: MODIS MOD08_M3 AOD 550 nm, Dark Target + Deep Blue combined, mean
sources.roughness: USGS GMTED2010 (std of elevation within 7.5-arcsec cells), cell mean (m)
sources.land: MODIS MCD12Q1 2020 LC_Type1 != 17 (water), majority at 0.5 deg
